summary: Review and refresh both exact Firefox warning baselines after the current wallet changes. 36 warnings remain: 35 DANGEROUS_EVAL and one UNSAFE_VAR_ASSIGNMENT; zero errors or notices.
review: Inspected every emitted warning site in both configurations. Function binding shims, get-intrinsic eval references, generator capability probes, core-js and lodash global fallbacks, the subwallet/Zod capability probe, and Vue static template insertion retain their reviewed behavior.

The previous 38-warning baseline included two Cardano WASM glue sites absent from the current vendored/shimmed build (third-party trimming commit df53384c). Fifteen existing sites moved from mountApp.js to SendForm.js as chunk composition changed. No new warning category or runtime site was introduced by the wallet fixes.

The keyless warning fingerprint matches the independently built unchanged ba1fb428 source: fd12069265b12df3015720bb5796ad53a2f07e606dcdd1014ab47074abc13d62. Final artifact hashes are separately pinned; matching warning sites do not imply identical bundles.
The store variant was built separately using the existing public provider configuration; its differing minified file locations and complete warning-bearing file hashes were reviewed independently.
The cache-failure follow-up changes only balance-service behavior and its unit tests. Its rebuilt production Firefox artifact is checked against the replacement store baseline.

The strict warning verifier and build warning policy are unchanged. New warnings, errors, notices, fingerprint drift, and warning-bearing artifact drift remain blocking. The ci-named file is the local keyless-build fixture; no hosted CI was required or modified.
